label: Quillon, meeting decisions API
html:
<style>
  @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Caveat:wght@500;700&family=Instrument+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500;700&family=Newsreader:ital,opsz,wght@0,6..72,400..700;1,6..72,400..600&family=Space+Grotesk:wght@500;600;700&display=swap');
  /* Quillon: a Berlin startup with one product, an API for meeting recordings. One 78rem grid on full-width bands;
     the hero puts the promise beside a working demo; numbers carry their units (ms, tokens, dollars per 1M). Fonts per
     look: Space Grotesk + Instrument Sans (Launch), JetBrains Mono (Terminal), Newsreader (Research); the margin notes
     are Caveat, mono comments or serif italics. */
  #in-ai {
    --background: oklch(0.985 0.004 270);
    --foreground: oklch(0.19 0.02 275);
    --card: oklch(1 0 0);
    --card-foreground: var(--foreground);
    --popover: oklch(1 0 0);
    --popover-foreground: var(--foreground);
    --muted: oklch(0.955 0.008 275);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.47 0.02 275);
    --border: oklch(0.19 0.02 275 / 0.11);
    --input: oklch(0.19 0.02 275 / 0.22);
    --primary: oklch(0.5 0.22 278);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.99 0.005 275);
    --secondary: oklch(0.95 0.02 278);
    --secondary-foreground: oklch(0.35 0.15 278);
    --accent: oklch(0.95 0.015 278);
    --accent-foreground: oklch(0.19 0.02 275);
    --ring: var(--primary);
    --chart-1: oklch(0.55 0.22 278);
    --chart-2: oklch(0.68 0.14 210);
    --chart-3: oklch(0.62 0.19 335);
    --chart-4: oklch(0.74 0.15 75);
    --chart-5: oklch(0.6 0.13 160);
    --radius: 0.625rem;
    --radius-sm: max(0px, calc(var(--radius) - 4px));
    --radius-md: max(0px, calc(var(--radius) - 2px));
    --radius-lg: var(--radius);
    --radius-xl: calc(var(--radius) + 4px);
    --ai-band: oklch(0.965 0.008 275);
    --ai-display: 'Space Grotesk', 'Instrument Sans', sans-serif;
    --ai-display-weight: 600;
    --ai-body: 'Instrument Sans', var(--font-sans);
    --ai-mono: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace;
    --ai-note-font: 700 1.35rem/1.05 'Caveat', cursive;
    --ai-note-ink: var(--primary);
    --ai-note-turn: -4deg;
    --ai-stamp: oklch(0.5 0.2 25);
    accent-color: var(--primary);
    color-scheme: light;
    container-type: inline-size;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    width: 100%;
    overflow-x: clip;
    background: var(--background);
    color: var(--foreground);
    font: 400 1rem/1.6 var(--ai-body);
  }
  #in-ai[data-look='terminal'] {
    --background: oklch(0.965 0.012 115);
    --foreground: oklch(0.22 0.04 150);
    --card: oklch(0.985 0.008 115);
    --popover: oklch(0.985 0.008 115);
    --muted: oklch(0.93 0.02 120);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.42 0.05 150);
    --border: oklch(0.22 0.04 150 / 0.16);
    --input: oklch(0.22 0.04 150 / 0.3);
    --primary: oklch(0.42 0.12 150);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.98 0.01 115);
    --secondary: oklch(0.92 0.03 130);
    --secondary-foreground: oklch(0.3 0.08 150);
    --accent: oklch(0.92 0.025 130);
    --accent-foreground: oklch(0.22 0.04 150);
    --chart-1: oklch(0.5 0.14 150);
    --chart-2: oklch(0.65 0.12 190);
    --chart-3: oklch(0.7 0.15 110);
    --chart-4: oklch(0.72 0.14 75);
    --chart-5: oklch(0.55 0.08 230);
    --radius: 0rem;
    --ai-band: oklch(0.94 0.018 120);
    --ai-display: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace;
    --ai-display-weight: 700;
    --ai-body: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace;
    --ai-note-font: 500 0.875rem/1.4 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    --ai-note-ink: var(--muted-foreground);
    --ai-note-turn: 0deg;
    --ai-stamp: var(--primary);
  }
  #in-ai[data-look='research'] {
    --background: oklch(0.97 0.014 85);
    --foreground: oklch(0.21 0.02 60);
    --card: oklch(0.99 0.008 85);
    --popover: oklch(0.99 0.008 85);
    --muted: oklch(0.935 0.02 80);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.45 0.03 60);
    --border: oklch(0.21 0.02 60 / 0.14);
    --input: oklch(0.21 0.02 60 / 0.26);
    --primary: oklch(0.44 0.13 25);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.98 0.01 85);
    --secondary: oklch(0.93 0.025 60);
    --secondary-foreground: oklch(0.35 0.1 25);
    --accent: oklch(0.93 0.025 80);
    --accent-foreground: oklch(0.21 0.02 60);
    --chart-1: oklch(0.48 0.13 25);
    --chart-2: oklch(0.5 0.08 240);
    --chart-3: oklch(0.65 0.1 70);
    --chart-4: oklch(0.55 0.06 150);
    --chart-5: oklch(0.6 0.05 300);
    --radius: 0.125rem;
    --ai-band: oklch(0.945 0.02 82);
    --ai-display: 'Newsreader', Georgia, serif;
    --ai-display-weight: 500;
    --ai-body: 'Newsreader', Georgia, serif;
    --ai-note-font: italic 400 1.05rem/1.35 'Newsreader', Georgia, serif;
    --ai-note-ink: var(--primary);
    --ai-note-turn: 0deg;
    --ai-stamp: var(--primary);
  }
  /* code in syntax colours: the token spans carry both themes; the listing's ground picks one */
  #in-ai [data-code-ground='light'] code span[style*='--shiki-light'] {
    color: var(--shiki-light);
  }
  #in-ai [data-code-ground='dark'] code span[style*='--shiki-dark'] {
    color: var(--shiki-dark);
  }
  #in-ai [hidden] {
    display: none !important;
  }
  /* one 78rem grid: every band runs full width, its content inside the computed padding */
  #in-ai > :is(header, section, footer) {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    width: 100%;
    padding-inline: max(clamp(1rem, 4vw, 2.5rem), calc((100% - 78rem) / 2));
  }
  #in-ai > section {
    padding-block: clamp(3.5rem, 8vw, 6rem);
    scroll-margin-top: 4.5rem;
  }
  #in-ai > .ai-band {
    background: var(--ai-band);
  }
  #in-ai :is(h1, h2, h3) {
    font-family: var(--ai-display);
    font-weight: var(--ai-display-weight);
    text-wrap: balance;
  }
  #in-ai :is(code, kbd, .ai-mono) {
    font-family: var(--ai-mono);
  }
  #in-ai a:not(.btn, .nav-menu-link, .mk-header-brand) {
    color: inherit;
    text-underline-offset: 0.25em;
  }
  #in-ai .ai-look-only {
    display: none;
  }
  #in-ai[data-look='launch'] .ai-pill.ai-look-only[data-for='launch'] {
    display: inline-flex;
  }
  #in-ai[data-look='launch'] .ai-look-only[data-for='launch'],
  #in-ai[data-look='terminal'] .ai-look-only[data-for='terminal'],
  #in-ai[data-look='research'] .ai-look-only[data-for='research'] {
    display: block;
  }
  #in-ai .ai-eyebrow {
    margin: 0 0 0.75rem;
    color: var(--primary);
    font: 600 0.8125rem/1.3 var(--ai-mono);
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  #in-ai .ai-head {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: end;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 1rem 3rem;
    margin-block-end: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3rem);
  }
  #in-ai .ai-head h2 {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: clamp(2rem, 1.3rem + 2.4cqi, 3.1rem);
    line-height: 1.08;
    letter-spacing: -0.025em;
  }
  #in-ai[data-look='terminal'] .ai-head h2 {
    letter-spacing: -0.04em;
  }
  #in-ai .ai-head p:not(.ai-eyebrow) {
    max-width: 34rem;
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    text-wrap: pretty;
  }
  /* the notes in the margin: a marker hand, a code comment, a reviewer's italics */
  #in-ai .ai-note {
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--ai-note-ink);
    font: var(--ai-note-font);
    rotate: var(--ai-note-turn);
  }
  #in-ai[data-look='terminal'] .ai-note::before {
    content: '// ';
  }
  #in-ai[data-look='research'] .ai-note {
    padding-inline-start: 0.75rem;
    border-inline-start: 2px solid var(--primary);
  }
  #in-ai .ai-note svg {
    display: block;
    width: 3.5rem;
    height: 2.5rem;
    margin-block-start: 0.25rem;
    fill: none;
    stroke: currentColor;
    stroke-width: 2;
    stroke-linecap: round;
    stroke-linejoin: round;
  }
  #in-ai:not([data-look='launch']) .ai-note svg {
    display: none;
  }
  /* the header */
  #in-ai .ai-bar {
    padding-inline: max(clamp(0.75rem, 3vw, 2.5rem), calc((100% - 78rem) / 2));
    border-block-end: 1px solid var(--border);
    background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--background) 88%, transparent);
    backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  }
  #in-ai .ai-bar .mk-header-inner {
    max-width: none;
    padding-inline: 0;
    gap: 0.75rem 1.5rem;
  }
  #in-ai .ai-bar .mk-header-brand,
  #in-ai .ai-bar .mk-header-name {
    color: var(--foreground);
  }
  #in-ai .ai-bar .mk-header-name {
    font: 700 1.3rem/1 var(--ai-display);
    letter-spacing: -0.03em;
  }
  #in-ai .ai-bar .mk-header-brand svg {
    width: 1.6rem;
    height: 1.6rem;
    color: var(--primary);
  }
  #in-ai .ai-bar .mk-header-nav {
    margin-inline-end: auto;
  }
  #in-ai .ai-bar .nav-menu-link {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
  }
  #in-ai .ai-bar .nav-menu-link:hover {
    color: var(--accent-foreground);
  }
  #in-ai .ai-controls {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
  }
  #in-ai .ai-controls .select {
    width: auto;
  }
  #in-ai .site-mode {
    flex: none;
    border: 1px solid var(--input);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    background: var(--background);
    color: var(--foreground);
  }
  #in-ai .site-mode:hover {
    background: var(--accent);
    color: var(--accent-foreground);
  }
  @container mk-header (max-width: 64rem) {
    #in-ai .ai-bar .mk-header-nav {
      display: none;
    }
    #in-ai .ai-bar .mk-header-menu {
      display: inline-flex;
    }
    #in-ai .ai-bar .mk-header-brand {
      margin-inline-end: auto;
    }
  }
  @container mk-header (max-width: 26rem) {
    #in-ai .ai-bar .mk-header-brand svg {
      display: none;
    }
  }
  /* the hero: the promise and the numbers beside the working demo */
  #in-ai .ai-hero {
    position: relative;
    isolation: isolate;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1.05fr);
    align-items: center;
    gap: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4.5rem);
    padding-block: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 5.5rem);
    overflow: clip;
  }
  #in-ai .ai-hero-shader {
    opacity: 0.85;
    mask-image: radial-gradient(58% 85% at 80% 50%, #000 25%, transparent 75%);
  }
  #in-ai[data-look='research'] .ai-hero-shader {
    display: none;
  }
  #in-ai .ai-hero.pattern-grid {
    --shape-ink: transparent;
  }
  #in-ai[data-look='research'] .ai-hero.pattern-grid {
    --shape-ink: color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 7%, transparent);
    --shape-pattern: 28px;
  }
  #in-ai .ai-hero h1 {
    margin: 0 0 1.5rem;
    font-size: clamp(2.6rem, 1.4rem + 4.4cqi, 4.9rem);
    line-height: 1;
    letter-spacing: -0.035em;
  }
  #in-ai[data-look='terminal'] .ai-hero h1 {
    font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 1.2rem + 3.6cqi, 4rem);
    letter-spacing: -0.05em;
  }
  #in-ai[data-look='research'] .ai-hero h1 {
    font-weight: 400;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  }
  #in-ai .ai-hero h1 em {
    font-style: normal;
    color: var(--primary);
  }
  #in-ai[data-look='research'] .ai-hero h1 em {
    font-style: italic;
  }
  #in-ai .ai-lede {
    max-width: 34rem;
    margin: 0 0 2rem;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 1.125rem;
    text-wrap: pretty;
  }
  #in-ai .ai-actions {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.75rem;
  }
  #in-ai .ai-specs {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 1rem;
    margin: 2.5rem 0 0;
    padding: 1.25rem 0 0;
    border-block-start: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  #in-ai .ai-specs div {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.1rem;
  }
  #in-ai .ai-specs dt {
    order: 2;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
  }
  #in-ai .ai-specs dd {
    margin: 0;
    font: 600 1.35rem/1.2 var(--ai-mono);
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  }
  #in-ai .ai-pill {
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    margin-block-end: 1.25rem;
    padding: 0.3rem 0.8rem 0.3rem 0.35rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: var(--card);
    color: var(--foreground);
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    text-decoration: none;
  }
  #in-ai .ai-pill b {
    padding: 0.1rem 0.5rem;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: var(--primary);
    color: var(--primary-foreground);
    font-size: 0.75rem;
  }
  #in-ai .ai-pill:hover {
    border-color: var(--primary);
  }
  #in-ai .ai-prompt {
    margin: 0 0 1.25rem;
    color: var(--primary);
    font: 500 0.9375rem/1.4 var(--ai-mono);
  }
  #in-ai .ai-cursor {
    display: inline-block;
    width: 0.6em;
    height: 1.1em;
    margin-inline-start: 0.2em;
    vertical-align: -0.2em;
    background: currentColor;
    animation: ai-blink 1.1s steps(1) infinite;
  }
  @keyframes ai-blink {
    50% {
      opacity: 0;
    }
  }
  #in-ai .ai-figure-caption {
    margin: 0.75rem 0 0;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
    font-style: italic;
  }
  #in-ai .ai-figure-caption b {
    font-style: normal;
    color: var(--foreground);
  }
  /* the demo window: a session replaying one exchange */
  #in-ai .ai-stage {
    position: relative;
  }
  #in-ai .ai-stage > .ai-note {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 0.4rem;
    margin: 0.6rem 0 0 1.25rem;
  }
  #in-ai .ai-stage > .ai-note svg {
    flex: none;
    margin: 0;
  }
  #in-ai .ai-demo {
    overflow: hidden;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: calc(var(--radius) + 0.375rem);
    background: var(--card);
    box-shadow: 0 30px 60px -30px oklch(0.2 0.05 275 / 0.45);
  }
  #in-ai[data-look='terminal'] .ai-demo {
    border: 1px solid var(--primary);
    box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 35%, transparent);
  }
  #in-ai .ai-demo-bar {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    padding: 0.6rem 0.75rem 0.6rem 1rem;
    border-block-end: 1px solid var(--border);
    background: var(--muted);
    font-size: 0.875rem;
  }
  #in-ai .ai-demo-bar p {
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 0;
    margin: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  #in-ai .ai-demo-bar code {
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
  }
  #in-ai .ai-live {
    flex: none;
    width: 0.55rem;
    height: 0.55rem;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: oklch(0.68 0.17 150);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.68 0.17 150 / 0.2);
  }
  #in-ai .ai-demo .session {
    height: clamp(26rem, 60vh, 32rem);
    background: var(--card);
  }
  #in-ai .ai-demo .session-content {
    padding: 1rem;
  }
  #in-ai .ai-demo .session-item {
    transition:
      opacity 0.35s ease,
      translate 0.35s ease;
    @starting-style {
      opacity: 0;
      translate: 0 0.5rem;
    }
  }
  #in-ai .ai-demo [data-ai-stream] > * {
    transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
    @starting-style {
      opacity: 0;
    }
  }
  #in-ai .ai-demo .avatar-fallback {
    background: var(--primary);
    color: var(--primary-foreground);
    font-weight: 700;
  }
  #in-ai .ai-file {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.6rem;
    padding: 0.55rem 0.8rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    background: var(--background);
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
  }
  #in-ai .ai-file svg {
    width: 1.1rem;
    height: 1.1rem;
    color: var(--primary);
  }
  #in-ai .ai-file small {
    display: block;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
  }
  #in-ai .ai-res-h {
    margin: 0.25rem 0 0.35rem;
    font-weight: 700;
  }
  #in-ai .ai-res {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.35rem;
    margin: 0 0 0.6rem;
    padding-inline-start: 1.2rem;
  }
  #in-ai .ai-res li::marker {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
  }
  #in-ai .ai-ts {
    display: inline-block;
    margin-inline-start: 0.3rem;
    padding: 0 0.35rem;
    border-radius: 0.3rem;
    background: var(--secondary);
    color: var(--secondary-foreground);
    font: 500 0.75rem/1.5 var(--ai-mono);
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  }
  #in-ai .ai-due {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
  }
  /* how it works */
  #in-ai .ai-how {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.1fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
    gap: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 4rem);
    align-items: start;
  }
  #in-ai .mk-process-step-title {
    font-family: var(--ai-display);
  }
  #in-ai .ai-how h3 {
    margin: 0 0 0.75rem;
    font-size: 1.1rem;
  }
  #in-ai .mockup-code {
    font-family: var(--ai-mono);
  }
  /* the API */
  #in-ai .ai-api {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.45fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
    gap: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 4rem);
    align-items: start;
  }
  #in-ai .ai-code {
    position: relative;
  }
  #in-ai .ai-code .ai-copy {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    right: 0;
  }
  #in-ai .ai-code .tab-content {
    padding-block-start: 1rem;
  }
  #in-ai .ai-code .tab-list {
    padding-inline-end: 6.5rem;
  }
  #in-ai .ai-facts {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0;
    margin: 0;
  }
  #in-ai .ai-facts div {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 8.5rem minmax(0, 1fr);
    gap: 1rem;
    padding-block: 0.8rem;
    border-block-end: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  #in-ai .ai-facts dt {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
  }
  #in-ai .ai-facts dd {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
  }
  #in-ai .ai-facts dd b {
    font-family: var(--ai-mono);
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  }
  /* benchmarks: the numbers, and how they were measured */
  #in-ai .ai-bench .mk-stats {
    max-width: none;
    padding: 0;
  }
  #in-ai .ai-bench .mk-stats-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 14rem), 1fr));
    gap: 2rem;
  }
  #in-ai .ai-bench .mk-stat-value {
    font-family: var(--ai-mono);
    font-size: clamp(2rem, 1.5rem + 1.5cqi, 2.6rem);
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  #in-ai .ai-bench .mk-stat-value small {
    margin-inline-start: 0.2rem;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.45em;
    font-weight: 500;
  }
  #in-ai .ai-p95 {
    position: relative;
    display: inline-block;
  }
  #in-ai .ai-p95 > svg {
    position: absolute;
    inset: -30% -14% -32% -12%;
    width: 126%;
    height: 162%;
    overflow: visible;
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  #in-ai .ai-p95 > svg path {
    fill: none;
    stroke: var(--ai-note-ink);
